THIS WEEK IN LOCAL GOVERNMENT

Weston's village board approved a $6.7 million contract to build a new Mountain Bay Metropolitan Police Department facility, and area residents heard early details of a potential $81–94 million DC Everest school referendum next spring.

  • Weston's board voted 7-0 to award the Mountain Bay Metro Police Department building contract to 8 Pine Inc. for $6.7 million, under the $7 million budget; a construction start is targeted for late September.
  • DC Everest school district leaders presented a long-range facility plan to the Weston board that could include an $81–94 million referendum in April 2027.
  • Kronenwetter's Parks Committee recommended the village board approve a $5,000 matching grant for the Bushka Park renovation and officially sanction a September 12 Bushka Park 5K/3K run-walk fundraiser.
  • Weston's Finance and Human Resources Committee recommended approving a 36-month Cintas uniform renewal, a one-year audit extension with Hawkins Ash, and a 2027 budget process calendar.
  • Kronenwetter's Plan Commission is set to consider a rezone of the Marathon County Highway Facility from B3, SF, and AR to M2 General Industrial and act on Certified Survey Maps for both that site and Happy Hollow Road.

Coming up: The Marathon County Board meets Tuesday, July 28 at 7:00 PM — worth watching alongside the county's Environmental Resources Committee that same evening at 5:00 PM. The Wausau School Board's Education & Operations Committee meets Monday, July 27 at 5:00 PM.
